No corn and no beans anywhere, and the flour tortillas replace the corn ones the carnitas recipe suggests.

dinners.name: Crispy Pork Carnitas Tacos with Lime Slaw & Pickled Onions
dinners.blurb: Pork shoulder simmered in orange, lime, garlic and cumin until the liquid is gone, then fried in its own fat until the edges crunch. It goes into warm flour tortillas with a sharp cabbage-lime slaw, quick-pickled red onion and feta. Chosen for this week's anchor deal, Publix boneless pork Boston butt at $3.29/lb.
dinners.warn: START BY 2:45 PM. It's 3+ hours, almost all of it hands-off. Or cook it Sunday after shopping: it holds, and Monday becomes a 10-minute re-crisp in a hot skillet. Either way, 1 1/4 lb of pork gets set aside for Wednesday BEFORE serving.

ingredients.group: Carnitas (scaled up from 3 lb to 5 lb; Wednesday needs the surplus)
items: 5 lb boneless pork Boston butt, cut into 2-inch cubes (trim only the thickest fat caps; the fat is what fries it)
1 3/4 tsp kosher salt, plus more to taste
Water, just enough to barely cover the meat
1/2 cup rice vinegar + 1/2 cup hot water
1/2 head green cabbage, finely shredded (the other half is Wednesday's)
1/2 bunch cilantro, chopped (the rest is Wednesday's)
2 limes: juice of 1 for the slaw, 1 cut into wedges
4 oz feta crumbles (one of the two packs)

directions: Put the cubed pork in your largest Dutch oven or heavy pot (7 qt or bigger; split it between two pots if it's crowded). Add the orange juice, lime juice, crushed garlic, cumin, salt, and enough water to barely cover the meat.
Bring to a boil, then lower to a steady simmer. Simmer UNCOVERED for 2 hours. Don't stir or touch it.

Meanwhile, make the pickled onion: whisk the vinegar, hot water, sugar and salt in a jar until dissolved, add the sliced onion, press it under and leave it on the counter. It's ready in 30 minutes and keeps all week.

After 2 hours, turn the heat to medium-high and boil off the liquid, 45-60 minutes with 5 lb in the pot, stirring and turning the pieces now and then. When the liquid is gone, only rendered pork fat is left.
Let the pork sizzle in that fat until it's browned at the edges, turning gently only as needed; it will want to fall apart, which is fine. Taste and add salt.
↻ SET ASIDE 1 1/4 LB (about 4 packed cups) of the crisped pork in a container and refrigerate it NOW, before anyone serves themselves. That's Wednesday's Cuban sandwiches.
While the pork crisps: toss the shredded cabbage and half the cilantro with the juice of 1 lime and a big pinch of salt. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in foil in a 300°F oven.
Serve the pork in the tortillas with slaw, pickled onion, feta, lime wedges and the pickled jalapeños on the side. Plan on 3-4 tacos for Paul.
dinners.reuse: Hands 1 1/4 lb of pork to Wednesday's Cubanos. The other half of the cabbage and the cilantro go to Wednesday's slaw, the second red onion to Thursday, and the second feta pack to Thursday. Leftover pickled onion is good on Tuesday's bowls.
dinners.alt: Crispy browned pork carnitas pieces in a cast-iron pot

dinners.name: Korean Beef Bowls with Sesame Spinach
dinners.blurb: Ground beef browned hard with scallions, garlic and a lot of fresh ginger, then glazed in soy, honey and rice vinegar. It goes over jasmine rice with sesame spinach, crisp cucumber and shredded carrot. Chosen for the Market ground beef 3-lb pack at $4.89/lb.
dinners.warn: Cook the FULL 4 cups of rice. Half of it is Thursday's.

ingredients.group: Beef (doubled from the 1-lb recipe so Paul is actually full)
items: 2 lb ground beef (from the 3-lb pack; freeze the last pound)
2 bunches green onions, minced (about 2 1/2 cups), divided
1/4 cup minced or finely grated fresh ginger
1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes (more on the table)
4 cups dry jasmine rice, a DOUBLE batch (half is Thursday's)
9 oz spinach, plus 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 clove garlic and a pinch of salt
2 cucumbers, thinly sliced (the third is Wednesday's)
Optional: a fried egg per bowl
Gochujang or sriracha, on the side

directions: Start the rice: all 4 cups of jasmine rice, cooked per the bag. It's the only thing that takes longer than 20 minutes.

Brown the beef in your largest skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into small pieces, about 6-8 minutes. Halfway through, add 2 Tbsp of the soy sauce and two-thirds of the green onions. The 3-lb pack isn't 93% lean like the recipe's, so spoon off the excess fat once it's browned. Stir in the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
In a small bowl, stir together the rice vinegar, honey, ginger, red pepper flakes and the remaining 4 Tbsp soy sauce.

Pour it over the beef and cook 2 minutes, stirring. Take it off the heat, stir in the 2 Tbsp sesame oil and scatter the rest of the green onions over it. Taste; add soy or more sesame oil if it wants it.
Spinach: in a second pan, warm 1 tsp sesame oil with the minced clove of garlic, pile in the spinach with a pinch of salt and toss 1-2 minutes until just wilted. Fry eggs now if you're doing them.
Build the bowls: rice, beef, spinach, cucumber and carrot, then sesame seeds. Gochujang or sriracha on the table.
↻ Spread the leftover rice (about 6 cups) on a sheet pan or wide container to cool fast, then cover and refrigerate. That's Thursday's base.
dinners.reuse: The double rice batch goes to Thursday. The cucumbers and carrots are shared with Wednesday's slaw, and Monday's leftover pickled onion goes well here.
dinners.alt: Korean ground beef over rice with carrots, cucumber and green onions

dinners.name: Cuban Sandwiches with Monday's Carnitas & Cabbage-Lime Slaw
dinners.blurb: Tampa's own sandwich: Monday's orange-garlic pork, ham, Gruyère, pickles and mustard, pressed in a buttered skillet until the bread shatters. A big cold cabbage-carrot-cucumber slaw with lime and cilantro goes on the side. No protein is cooked tonight; it rides Monday's $3.29/lb pork plus two BOGO FREE deals, Greenfield uncured ham and Emmi Le Gruyère.

ingredients.group: Sandwiches (6, cut from 2 loaves; Paul gets 2)
items: 2 loaves Publix Cuban bread, each cut into 3 lengths and split
1 1/4 lb of Monday's carnitas (set aside Monday)
8 oz Gruyère, thinly sliced (most of the two Emmi packs)
Dill pickle sandwich slices, 3-4 per sandwich
1/2 head green cabbage, finely shredded (the other half of Monday's)
The rest of the cilantro, chopped
Juice of 2 limes, 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp kosher salt

directions: Make the slaw first so it has a few minutes to soften: toss the cabbage, carrot, cucumber and cilantro with the lime juice, olive oil and salt. Taste and add salt if it needs it.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Warm and lightly brown Monday's pork and the ham slices, a couple of minutes per side, then move them to a plate.
Brush the cut sides of the bread with melted butter and toast them cut-side down in the skillet for about 2 minutes, until lightly golden. Work in batches.
Build the sandwiches: pork, then ham, then Gruyère and pickles on the bottom halves. Spread mustard on the top halves and close them up.
Brush the outside of each sandwich, top and bottom, with butter.

Turn the skillet to medium-high. Put in 2 sandwiches, lay a sheet of parchment on top and press them down with a heavy pot or a second skillet, weighted with cans if you need to. Cook 3 minutes a side, until golden and the cheese has melted. Repeat with the rest, keeping the finished ones on a rack in a 250°F oven.
Rest 1 minute, cut on the diagonal and serve with the slaw.
dinners.reuse: Built entirely on Monday's surplus pork, plus the second half of Monday's cabbage and cilantro and the last of Tuesday's cucumbers and carrots.
dinners.alt: Pressed Cuban sandwiches with pork, ham, melted cheese and pickles

dinners.name: Fall Chicken Sheet Pan with Butternut Squash, Brussels Sprouts & Feta
dinners.blurb: Chicken, butternut squash, Brussels sprouts and red onion roasted hot in smoked paprika, cumin and a pinch of cinnamon, then broiled under feta until it chars. Served over Tuesday's rice. Chosen for Perdue boneless skinless chicken breasts at $4.49/lb; the squash ($1.29/lb) and Brussels sprouts (2 for $5) are on the ad too.
dinners.warn: The recipe is written for thighs. With breasts, the vegetables go in 10 minutes AHEAD of the chicken so the chicken doesn't dry out.

items: 2 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 medium butternut squash, peeled and diced small (about 3-4 cups)
2 pkg Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved (about 4 cups)
About 6 cups of Tuesday's cooked jasmine rice, to serve

directions: Heat the oven to 425°F with racks in the upper and lower thirds. Mix all the spices and the salt in a small bowl.
Microwave the whole squash for 2-3 minutes so it's easier to peel and cut, then peel and dice it small.

In a large bowl, toss the squash, Brussels sprouts and red onion with 1 1/2 Tbsp olive oil and half the spice mix. Spread them in an even layer across TWO rimmed sheet pans; one pan will steam instead of roast. Roast 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, toss the chicken pieces with the remaining 1 Tbsp olive oil and the rest of the spice mix.
Pull the pans, nestle the chicken in among the vegetables and roast another 18-20 minutes, swapping the pans halfway, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the squash is tender.
Scatter the feta over both pans and broil 2-3 minutes, one pan at a time, until it melts and chars at the edges. Watch it closely.
While it broils, reheat Tuesday's rice, covered, in the microwave with a splash of water. Serve the sheet pan over the rice.
dinners.reuse: Sits on Tuesday's double rice batch. It uses the second red onion and the second feta pack.
dinners.alt: Sheet pan of roasted chicken, butternut squash and Brussels sprouts topped with charred feta
